observations.body: John’s wilderness proclamation joins repentance with the nearness of the Kingdom of Heaven.
observations.label: The Kingdom of Heaven draws near

observations.body: The passage places God’s Kingdom beside the kingdom of heaven draws near.
observations.label: God’s Kingdom

payload.posture: Read Matthew 3:1–4 as evidence about the Kingdom, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states john’s wilderness proclamation joins repentance with the nearness of the Kingdom of Heaven. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Kingdom.
payload.title: The Kingdom of Heaven draws near
